script: On April 13, 2029, an asteroid called Apophis will pass very close to Earth. It will come closer than some of our satellites, about 32,000 kilometers away. It is about 340 meters wide. People in parts of the world will be able to see it with their own eyes. Scientists have ruled out any chance of it hitting Earth for at least 100 years.
